result.brief: 提出混合流世界-动作模型 UniWAM，用独立动作编码器与输出头共享主干，联合导航与操作数据，并引入操作锚点姿态监督与百万级数据，实现移动操作统一策略。
result.reason: Unified world-action model for mobile manipulation with mixed-stream world modeling, anchor pose supervision, and large-scale egocentric data; directly matches embodied world models and planning control.
